description: This shell script is a test script for verifying the behavior of 'git fast-import --signed-tags' with various GPG, GPGSM, and SSH signed tags. It sets up test cases, imports signed tags, and checks the import behavior under different signing modes and formats.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label and command sequence.

methods.name: test_expect_success GPG
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with 'GPG' label, for signing, importing, and verification of GPG signed tags.

methods.name: test_expect_success GPGSM
methods.description: Defines a test case for setting up and importing X.509 signed tags, verifying signature stripping with 'warn-strip' mode.

methods.name: test_expect_success GPGSSH
methods.description: Defines a test case for SSH signed tags, verifying import and signature modes.
